question: Find the paper on bromine substitution in lead-free CsSnI3 perovskite solar cells. Give its DOI and the reason the paper gives for the improved open-circuit voltage.
final_answer: The paper on bromine substitution in lead-free CsSnI3 perovskite solar cells has the DOI 10.1021/jp5126624. The paper attributes the improved open-circuit voltage ($V_{\rm oc}$) to the decrease in tin ($\text{Sn}$) vacancies, which is reflected by lower charge carrier densities of $10^{15}\text{ cm}^{-3}$ and a high resistance to charge recombination in the bromine-rich $\text{CsSnI}_{3-x}\text{Br}_x$ samples.
